code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert resolved value
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value
       Returns or sets resolved (actual) value.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value (VALUE)?

DESCRIPTION
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value ;
	   Returns resolved (actual) value.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value VALUE ;
	   Sets resolved (actual) value.

RETURN VALUE
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value ;
	   Returns resolved (actual) value.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value VALUE ;
	   No return value (sets resolved (actual) value).

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "original Alert resolved value: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value]."
	    ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value new_value
	    log local0. "new Alert resolved value: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
